note: Dental Implant Marketing Index cohort (founder brief, 16 October 2026): five selected Ontario dental clinics, compared for how they present and promote implant consultations. A fixed editorial selection, not a ranking and not a sample of Ontario dentistry. Never substitute, add or drop a clinic silently; a clinic that cannot be verified stays in the cohort with its limitation. Reserve candidates are recorded for possible later editions only and never appear on the page.
scope: Ontario, initial comparison focused on the Greater Toronto Area
